description: Mall Deco is an architectural design that was prominent from 1980s to the 1990s, often labeled as the retro-mall aesthetic, with a touch of minimalism, plant-focused motifs and incorporated soft/pastel color palettes, characterized by a diffusion of futuristic neon, lush interior landscapes and late-stage Art Deco revival. It can feature sunken courtyards such as the central gathering hubs layered with built-in concrete seating, expansive planter beds and multi-tiered steps.
